model: Weathermaster 48/50P2-P5 030-100 Large Rooftop (ComfortLink 7.x, UPC Open BACnet option)
applies_to: Carrier Weathermaster 48/50P2, P3, P4 and P5 030-100 single-package large rooftop units with ComfortLink version 7.x controls and the UPC Open BACnet option.
summary: This is the ComfortLink 7.x generation of the 48/50P large rooftop. BACnet MS/TP comes from a UPC Open controller in its own enclosure below the main control box, which reads the ComfortLink board over CCN. The list has 285 AVs and BVs: occupancy, setpoints, air temperatures, pressures and CFM, building and duct static pressure, compressor relays and timeguards, economizer, demand levels, Humidi-MiZer and VFD values, thermostat inputs, alarms and spare user values.
default_device_instance: Network number 16101 followed by the MAC address (MAC 20 gives 1610120)
notes: Form 48/50P-8T (8-19) for ComfortLink 7.x units. The 48/50P030-100 with ComfortLink 9.x (48-50P-15T) has a different list: only about 115 of these object IDs are shared.
Object names end in _1. Descriptions are the printed point descriptions, with the CCN point name added where two rows share a description.
Units printed as dF are shown as °F; ^F and deltaF as Δ°F (temperature differences). Ranges and defaults are left out.
This is ComfortLink + UPC Open, not the SystemVu or SmartVu controls used on other Carrier rooftops.

source.title: Weathermaster 48/50P2,P3,P4,P5030-100 Single Package Large Rooftop Units with ComfortLink Version 7.X Controls - Controls, Start-Up, Operation, Service and Troubleshooting (Appendix F: UPC Open Controller, Table AP Network Points List)

integration.summary: The BMS talks BACnet MS/TP to the UPC Open, which reads and writes the ComfortLink control over CCN. Clear Local Machine Disable, set the CCN schedule number for the occupancy source you want, then write occupancy, setpoints and (for VAV) the supply air setpoint; read HVAC mode, temperatures and alarm state. Values the BMS feeds in (space, return or outdoor temperature, RH, CO2) are forces that clear if not refreshed.

minimum_points.name: sat_1
minimum_points.why: Supply air temperature leaving the fan

minimum_points.name: comm_lost_alm_1
minimum_points.why: UPC lost CCN communication with the unit

integration.enable: The unit ships with Local Machine Disable (Service Test > STOP, BV 59 unitstop_1) set to Yes; set it to No before the unit runs. Occupancy follows the ComfortLink CCN schedule number (Configuration > CCN > SC.OV > SCH.N): 0 = always occupied, 1 = local schedule (default), 65-99 = a CCN schedule. The points list makes Occupied? (BV 2008) writable, but the manual does not describe how a write interacts with SCH.N; test it on site.
integration.heartbeat: The manual says forces at CCN priority 7 clear unless rewritten in time: outside air temperature, outside RH, outside air quality and static pressure reset after 30 minutes, return air and space temperature after 3 minutes.
integration.remote_sensors: Space Temperature (AV 137), Return Air Temperature (AV 135), Outside Air Temperature (AV 1003), Outside Air RH (AV 119), IAQ (AV 1009) and OAQ (AV 113) are writable. Refresh them within the force timeouts (3 min for space and return temperature, 30 min for outdoor values).
setup: Set the MAC address on the UPC Open's Tens and Ones rotary switches; the controller reads switches, DIP switches and jumpers only at power-up.
Device instance = network number (default 16101) followed by the MAC address, e.g. MAC 20 gives 1610120.
BAS port: DS3 enable, DS4 E1-485, DS5-DS8 set to MSTP; baud on DS1-DS2 (9600, 19.2k, 38.4k or 76.8k, Carrier default 76.8k); 8N1 fixed. EIA-485 jumpers to EIA-485 and 2W.
Fit a BT485 terminator on the first and last controller of the MS/TP segment.
The UPC Open and the ComfortLink board must use the same CCN element and bus numbers (factory 1 and 0).
gotchas: Points depend on unit options (heat type, economizer, Humidi-MiZer, VFDs, building pressure control); objects for options not fitted carry no useful data.
The user-defined analog and binary values are spare objects with no unit function.
